title: AgentTrace Protocol 2.0 becomes mandatory for all MCP server implementations
summary: A blog post states that AgentTrace Protocol 2.0 is now required for every MCP server. No specification, no repository, and no other outlet carries the claim.

title: VelocityAgent claims 12x faster tool calling than LangChain
summary: A single tweet thread claims VelocityAgent outperforms LangChain on tool dispatch by 12x. No benchmarks, no repository linked.

title: LangChain and LangGraph Agent Frameworks Reach v1.0 Milestones
summary: LangChain 1.0 and LangGraph 1.0 are the frameworks' first major versions. LangGraph v1 deprecates the create_react_agent prebuilt in favor of LangChain's new create_agent function, which adds a middleware system for customization.
